visualAcceptance.routeReadability: accepted for the courtyard-to-Siloam crop; the retained route is continuous and excludes later-story space
visualAcceptance.identityContinuity: accepted for private preview; pinned Jesus clothing and face vocabulary retained
visualAcceptance.poseAndStateClarity: accepted for the blind, clay-applied, seeing, and clay-action states used by John 9:1-7
visualAcceptance.theologicalRestraint: accepted; no halo, glow, beam, fantasy particles or theatrical miracle effect

limitations: The generated world is a stylized neutral gameplay composition, not a historical reconstruction.
The runtime world is an audited, unscaled composite of the courtyard and Siloam crops over a neutral fill; unused later-region painting is absent.
The world base is a single painted two-dimensional courtyard-to-Siloam composition aligned to canonical anchors; collision and navigation remain canonical metadata rather than pixel-derived geometry.
The pinned Jesus vendor sheet provides four-direction idle and two-step walk frames through deterministic byte-copy extraction.

Observer walk frames, true disciple up/down idles, and the required man-born-blind state/directional frames remain blocked because the built-in image-generation tool is unavailable; no CLI fallback or substitute art was used.
Dialogue portraits were not generated because the current UI has no portrait surface.
All generated and pinned packs remain non-release-eligible until rights and public redistribution review.
